name: In The Dark
source:
You are lost in a cave, your lamp has shattered and you must rely on your other senses to make your way to the exit.

[from [url=https://judithan.itch.io/in-the-dark]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个山洞里迷路了，你的灯破碎了，你必须依靠你的其他感官才能找到出口。

[来自[url=https://judithan.itch.io/in-the-dark]itch.io[/url]]
